meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名和作者，自动生成专业网文封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为网文生成专业封面而不懂设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate a novel cover with title and author from book info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a polished cover for your web novel

howto.what: 装上后,给它书名、笔名、目标平台和输出目录,它会判定题材风格、拼好英文提示词,生成带中文书名和署名的小说封面并保存,还能裁成平台上传尺寸。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-cover 或 /封面,或者说「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」等要求时接管。原文要求书名和笔名缺任一必须先问用户补齐。

say.text: 给《青云仙途》做封面,笔名青山客,要番茄小说尺寸
say.note: 缺书名或笔名会先问你补齐

say.text: 换构图 B,人物特写加场景,再出一版
say.note: 每个构图方案单独生成一次

say.text: 把封面裁成 600x800 的上传版
say.note: 原图保留,另存 _上传 版

howto.what_en: Give it a book title, pen name, target platform and output dir; it infers the genre style, builds an English prompt and renders a cover with Chinese title and author name via GPT-Image-2, then crops it to platform upload size.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story-cover or /封面, or requests like 'make a novel cover'. It asks for the missing book title or pen name before starting.

say_en.text: Make a cover for 'Qingyun Xiantu', pen name Qingshanke, Fanqie size
say_en.note: Asks for any missing title or pen name first

say_en.text: Try composition B, close-up character plus scene, one more version
say_en.note: Each composition is generated in its own call

say_en.text: Export a 600x800 upload version of the cover
say_en.note: Keeps original, saves an upload copy
